steps: Add the bananas, coconut sugar, and almond butter to a blender. Blend until no large chunks of banana remain.
Add the baking powder, cinnamon, salt, and oat flour. Blend until combined, taking care not to over-blend.
Add the chopped nuts and stir or pulse them in.
Drop spoonfuls of batter onto a baking pan, leaving room between each cookie as they will spread slightly. Sprinkle extra nuts on top if desired.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the bottom edges are golden brown.
Remove from the oven and cool for at least 10 minutes before eating.
